decisive.rationale: Cyclin D1 overexpression with CCND1::IGH defines MCL irrespective of CD23/CD200.
A CLL-phenotype clone below 5 x10^9/L without lymphadenopathy, organomegaly or cytopenias is MBL.
Loss of cyclin D1/t(11;14)/SOX11 with gain of CD23 and CD200 converts the phenotype to CLL.
Cyclin D1 with t(11;14) and CD5 defines MCL even with CD10.
BRAF wild-type, annexin A1 and CD25 negative hairy-cell-like disease is SBLPN (formerly HCL-variant).
Cyclin D1 with t(11;14) defines MCL; CD5-negative MCL exists.
MYD88 L265P with IgM paraprotein and plasmacytic differentiation favours LPL over MZL.
Cyclin D1 with t(11;14) defines MCL.
CD10/BCL6 with IGH::BCL2 and follicular architecture defines FL.

anchor_loss.rationale: Cyclin D1-negative MCL exists (CCND2/3); SOX11 retained.
BRAF wild-type HCL is rare; phenotype retained.
MYD88 wild-type LPL (~10%); IgM paraprotein retained.
CD23/CD200-negative CLL phenotype; cyclin D1 negative retained.
SMZL by exclusion without villous cells or del(7q).

findings.pos_text: Complex karyotype with 5 or more abnormalities.
Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential villous projections (hairy cells) are present.
Lymphocytes with short polar villi (villous lymphocytes) are present.
Many cells show a prominent central nucleolus.
A follicular growth pattern with back-to-back neoplastic follicles is seen.
The infiltrate comprises predominantly centrocytes with scattered centroblasts.
findings.neg_text: No centrocytes or centroblasts are seen.

findings.pos_text: A mantle zone growth pattern is present.
findings.neg_text: No mantle zone pattern is seen.

findings.pos_text: A lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and occasional Dutcher bodies is present.
Monocytoid B cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are present.
An intrasinusoidal pattern of infiltration is present in the trephine.
An interstitial infiltrate of cells with clear cytoplasm and a fried-egg appearance is present.
The aspirate was a dry tap; the trephine shows increased reticulin fibrosis.
findings.neg_text: No reticulin fibrosis; the aspirate was adequate.

findings.pos_text: Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy (nodes up to 3 cm).
Pancytopenia (Hb 94 g/L, neutrophils 0.8 x10^9/L, platelets 76 x10^9/L).
findings.neg_text: No cytopenias (Hb 138 g/L, neutrophils 3.9 x10^9/L, platelets 231 x10^9/L).

findings.pos_text: Serum electrophoresis: IgM kappa paraprotein 21 g/L.
Serum electrophoresis: IgG kappa paraprotein 8 g/L.
Presentation with an extranodal mass (gastric biopsy).
B symptoms (night sweats and 6 kg weight loss).
